title: Brandon Fugal: Skinwalker Ranch phenomenon is reflective
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Brandon Fugal: Skinwalker Ranch phenomenon is reflective, about 2020s at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh Brandon Fugal uses it when he goes to Skinwalker Ranch. He says clearly >> the phenomena is reflective.

plain: Researcher Grant Cameron says on Jesse Michels's podcast that Brandon Fugal, who goes to Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, says clearly that the phenomenon there is "reflective". By that, Cameron means it seems to mirror the people observing it. If true, what witnesses see would depend partly on who they are.
